title: Strategy options: raise Netflix operating margin by 1 percentage point through the device experience (ADR-0099 document cycle, PR-F soak #1)
summary: Operator goal (2026-09-09): build a strategy to increase the Netflix profit margin by 1 percentage point by improving the device experience (TV/streaming-device apps, partner integrations, playback quality, device-side cost-to-serve). This is a DOCUMENT deliverable: several mechanistically distinct candidate strategies, a comparison-driven recommendation, and an evidence file every number cites. Goal type for the scout header: strategy-options.
root_cause: n/a — a solution cycle, not a defect. The factory's first document deliverable on the code spine (ADR-0099): scout/intent unchanged in role, build diverges into options, audit judges them, tdd released by the kernel signal.
fix: Scout declares goal_type: strategy-options and deliverable_kind: document (report header + per-task Deliverable kind bullet); triage re-declares the kind; build delivers <deliverable_root>/netflix-margin-device-experience/ per the rendered Task Contract (options with a different mechanism each — e.g. device-side cost-to-serve, ARPU via device partner economics, churn via playback/quality, partner bundle placement); recommendation with an Options Compared matrix, the runner-up and the evidence that would flip the choice; assumptions-and-evidence with sourced numbers (public filings, published research) — unsourced numbers are explicit assumptions. Self-check with evolve solution check before handoff; audit grades with path:line evidence and steelmans the non-recommended options.
acceptance: At least two candidate strategies, each changing a DIFFERENT mechanism (not the same lever at three sizes), each with a causal chain to operating margin and a quantified expected effect resting on a named assumption.
The recommendation follows from the Options Compared matrix, names the runner-up, and states the evidence that would flip the choice.
Every quantitative claim in the options and the recommendation cites an entry in the evidence file whose source supports the magnitude and direction; unsourced numbers are labelled assumptions.
evolve solution check netflix-margin-device-experience exits 0; the audit report cites path:line evidence per criterion and per option.
The routing plan justifies tdd as not run (document deliverable) and the cycle ships under the solution(netflix-margin-device-experience) prefix.
notes: PR-F soak item #1 (plan review-the-current-pipeline-tidy-sonnet.md). Expected per cycle: routing-plan tdd:false with a document justification and the strategy-options domain inserts (premise-challenge, forces-analysis, market-sizing, scope-baseline before build, adversarial-review after); solution-scout/-build/-audit preloaded on scout/build/audit; first deep-tier dispatch status bar reads gpt-5.6-sol high (the 2026-09-10 cost directive).
